sentences.text: Larsonvenator was a tyrannosauroid theropod dinosaur, a member of the group that includes the famous Tyrannosaurus rex.
The type species of the genus is Larsonvenator elegans.
The genus was formally described by paleontologists Sancarlo and Paul.
Larsonvenator lived during the Maastrichtian stage of the Late Cretaceous period.
Its fossils have been recovered from the Hell Creek Formation, a well-known Late Cretaceous deposit in the United States.
Specimens are known specifically from the region of Montana.
